editorial.blurb: China Gourmet serves up generous portions of classic Chinese takeout with bold, familiar flavors that hit the spot for a quick weeknight craving.
editorial.insiderTip: Order for takeaway rather than dine-in for the best experience; delivery times can stretch beyond estimates, so pick up in person when possible.

topDishes.note: Savory and satisfying without being too heavy
Crispy and saucy when prepared well
